name: opencoreemr/oce-module-sinch-conversations-tools-openemr
description: OpenEMR source tree for static analysis (PHPStan) and the e2e Docker bind mount. Pinned to the public upstream openemr/openemr v8_1_0 release tag (8.1 line) so analysis resolves the 8.1 APIs the module targets (e.g. CsrfUtils' required SessionInterface) and the e2e stack boots a stable released core. Public clone, no credentials needed. Not a runtime dependency of the module — see issue #118.
